title.title: $P = W$ for $\mathrm{SL}_n$ in every rank
title.subtitle: Claim: for $\mathrm{SL}_n$ the perverse filtration equals the weight filtration in every composite rank, completing $P = W$

plain: Two very different ways to sort the same shape's holes, one by geometry and one by algebra, always agree

voice.text: P equals W says two filtrations on the same cohomology agree.
One comes from the Hitchin fibration, the other from Hodge theory.
Claimed: every rank, completing fixed-determinant P equals W.

sources.quote: this gives P = W for SL_n in every rank n ≥ 2
